name: Colorado Mountain Cabin
address: 10875 Belvidere Ave, Green Mountain Falls, CO 80819
short_description: Historic 1920s cabin with massage table, playground, and valley-view deck, completely refurbished.
full_description:
The village of Green Mountain Falls is one of Colorado's premier family vacation spots. Trout fishing, mountain climbing, hiking, shopping or dining, swimming, horseback riding or just relaxing with the wild life is the essence of a great family vacation. The hospitality of this village is second to none.

Our cabin, located at 10875 Belvidere, has been in our family for many years – mostly used as a 2nd home – a summer get-a-way. It is located on the lower road (Belvidere) and is tucked away between Belvidere and Kansas Ave. To reach the carport, you actually drive up Kansas Avenue and you will arrive just above the front door of the Cabin. This house is adjacent to our private family home at 10885 Belvidere.

Just outside the front door, you will discover a wonderful playground for children. This home was one of the original cabins of Green Mountain Falls….probably built in the 1920's or earlier. It has been completely refurbished and even air conditioned. There is a small wood burning fireplace in the living room and a memory foam pull-out sofa bed. The Master Bedroom is equipped with a King size bed and also has a wonderful massage table…for in house massage service. Outside is an oversized deck that overlooks the valley below. Wildlife is abundant and several hiking trails are close to the house.

For entertainment, there is one flat screen television with DVD and Cable, as well as various games, movies, puzzles and books. You will enjoy a small fishing lake with a gazebo located right in the middle of the downtown area, among the shops, great restaurants and cafes. It is close to Woodland Park, Colorado Springs, and Pikes Peak. There are a multitude of activities all around the Green Mountain Falls area. The town is known for the beautiful Falls – which is a short hike to the first set of Falls, or you can do a longer hike to the second set of Falls. There is a lovely public outdoor swimming pool and tennis courts just around the corner from the small lake located in the center of the village.

This cabin is ideally suited for a group of 2-4 people. The bed sleep 2 and there is a sleeper sofa. The cabin is well suited for small birthday parties, business retreats, weddings, wedding anniversaries, honeymoons, Air Force graduations, or any other special occasion. You can enjoy the cooler climate at an elevation of 8,700 ft. surrounded by aspens, pines and interesting wildlife. You will be just minutes away from all of the Pikes Peak region attractions such as Garden of the Gods, Cave of the Winds, Manitou Cliff Dwellings, Pikes Peak Cog Railway, Seven Falls, and the famous Flying W Ranch. The Royal Gorge and river rafting are only an hour drive and the historic mining town of Cripple Creek is only 35 miles away. There are bountiful activities such as hiking, biking, fishing, horseback riding, antique shopping, museums, and fine arts. We know you will enjoy your visit to this beautiful mountain village.

Note: No Clothes Washer or Dryer in this Cabin — There are nearby coin operated Laundry Mat if needed.
